title: Ticking

Part 4. His watch started again. Thirty seconds to midnight. ⌚

Original fiction. Part 5 tomorrow night.

#scarystories #horrorstory #creepy #storytime #fyp

scenes.narration: Last time: Delia explained that Merrow Falls has held off midnight for twenty-seven years, and then Theo's watch began to tick.
scenes.image: a ticking wristwatch on a man's wrist inside a shop full of silent clocks

scenes.narration: Eleven fifty-nine and thirty seconds. The second hand swept forward like it had somewhere to be.
scenes.image: extreme close-up of a watch face in lamplight, the second hand a blur

scenes.narration: Delia grabbed his wrist. Take it off. Break it. He tried. The clasp wouldn't open. The glass wouldn't crack.
scenes.image: an old woman gripping a man's wrist with both hands, both straining

scenes.narration: Outside, the band stopped. The streamers stopped moving in the wind. Every face in the square turned toward the clock shop.
scenes.image: a crowd in 1990s party clothes in a snowy square, all turned toward a lit shop window

scenes.narration: One small watch, ticking, in a town that hasn't heard a single tick in twenty-seven years. Everyone could hear it.
scenes.image: faces pressed close to a frosted shop window, listening, breath fogging the glass

scenes.narration: Thirty-five. Forty. The sky over Merrow Falls began to lean.
scenes.image: a heavy dark sky bending low over a small snowy town, an eerie pale glow at its center

scenes.narration: Delia whispered: you brought it. Every year you come, you bring a little time in with you. This year you brought enough.
scenes.image: the old clockmaker's face lit from below, whispering urgently

scenes.narration: The crowd began walking toward the shop. Not running. Walking. Party hats on. Champagne in hand. Still smiling.
scenes.image: smiling townspeople in party hats walking slowly through the snow toward the camera

scenes.narration: Fifty. Fifty-one. Theo ran for the back door. Delia didn't follow. She was winding the grandfather clock, faster and faster, trying to hold the minute shut.
scenes.image: an old woman frantically winding a tall grandfather clock in a dark shop

scenes.narration: Fifty-seven. Fifty-eight. And across the whole town, every frozen clock gave one single, enormous tick.
scenes.image: a snowy town square at night with the clock tower glowing, snow suddenly shaken from every rooftop
